determinism.seed: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python3 seed_data.py at image build time
determinism.verified: byte-identical instance/ vs instance_seed/ after in-image rebuild (sha256 pinned in the build log); local-workspace rebuilds may differ from the in-image artifact - the determinism contract is the in-image rebuild
